description: This PHP source file defines the class DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Maintenance PurgeStrategy namespace. It implements logic to purge candidate entities based on certain criteria, notably removing candidates who have not consented to data retention.

classes.name: DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class responsible for purging candidate data that does not have the user's consent to keep their data. It extends the PurgeStrategy and overrides the purge method to implement its specific logic.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Executes the purge process for candidates associated with a specific vacancy ID, removing those who have not given consent to keep their data.
